title: The boundary of a living system is a Markov blanket

statements.text: The boundary that sets a living system apart is a Markov blanket: the states that make its internal states conditionally independent of its external states. It need not coincide with a membrane or skin.

sources.quote: (i) any living system is a Markov blanketed system and (ii) the boundaries of such systems need not be co-extensive with the biophysical boundaries of a living organism.
In our case, the dissociative boundary of an alter is the Markov blanket, whose revealed appearance is our skin and other sense organs.
the cell membrane implements a Markov Blanket (MB) that renders its interior conditionally independent of its exterior
These aspects of the free energy principle suggest that the entire edifice of active inference reaches right down into the autopoietic nature of living systems.
